root_cause_hypothesis: The invoice was submitted for payment before the goods were logged as received in the ERP system. This is likely a timing issue where the vendor's billing department is faster than our receiving department.
recommended_action: Contact the warehouse or purchasing department to confirm if goods for PO-45001 have arrived. If received, request them to post the Goods Receipt Note (GRN) in the ERP.
evidence_used: Invoice po_number 'PO-45001' corresponds to ERP grn_records['PO-45001'] which has a status of 'received': false.
business_rule_triggered: A valid PO exists but there is no GRN record, or the GRN record says received=false.
communication_draft:
Dear ABC Office Supplies Team,

We are writing in reference to your invoice #1 for $1250.00, corresponding to our Purchase Order PO-45001.

We are currently unable to process this invoice as our records indicate that the goods for this order have not yet been received. To resolve this discrepancy, could you please provide a proof of delivery?

We will place this invoice on hold until we can confirm receipt of the goods.

Please provide an update or the requested documentation within 5 business days so we can proceed with processing your payment.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards,

Accounts Payable Team
